scope: Only two delivery runtime helpers changed; no production/model/kernel source or inference binary changed.

path_conversion.failure_evidence: telemetry/telemetry-startup.jsonl logs each attempt; persistent failure raises explicit error before any child starts.

child_lifetime: finally covers path conversion, partial process/thread startup, main loop and errors; only this instance's child objects receive wait/terminate/kill escalation. Open stderr handles close on failed Popen. Unexpected child exit becomes explicit collector error.

required: Windows physical status ok with integer total/available counters
Windows GPU status ok with nonempty adapter counter data
formal_baseline.sample_contract: Correct before_load phase, at or after baseline start, at most5seconds old. No memory value threshold.
formal_baseline.failure_behavior: Save failed readiness checks; do not attempt Gufo launch; finally signal owned collector stop and preserve missing-data status.

covered: Transient ENOENT succeeds on retry and records failure
Second path conversion fails before any Popen
Second child Popen failure cleans first child and both stderr handles
Delayed GPU samples succeed within extra bound
RAM values zero accepted: no memory quantity threshold
Missing Linux baseline fails at deadline
Empty GPU adapter array is not ready
Coordinator failure invokes no runtime launch and stops only its collector

limits: The original C converted collector gap remains a historical gap. This does not repair or backfill missing samples.
This is collector startup/cleanup validation, not model/GPU numerical qualification or formal performance/headroom measurement.
Retry handles bounded transient failures; persistent Windows or path failures still stop qualification before model launch.
